seam_census.basis: Digest-bound workflow state creation, validation and transition rules exist in the exact owner tree.
Current owner tree contains capability routing and execution-plan modules; Phase 2 exact-subject evidence already closed their governed contracts.
Concurrency module deliberately derives eligibility only and forbids execution/schedule/scheduler fields. This does not establish a scheduler runtime.
Checkpoint creation and validation are implemented and digest-bound, but prior exact-subject closure explicitly made no durable-persistence claim.
Receipt creation/validation is implemented with immutable bindings and zero canonical effect, while prior closure explicitly made no durable-persistence claim.
Existing handoff is intentionally unable to execute or emulate canonical Book admission.

The complete exact Book implementation subtree contains no durable workflow/checkpoint/receipt store or repository adapter. State, checkpoint and evidence modules construct and validate objects in memory; Phase 2 cancellation/resume and evidence/provenance closures explicitly withheld durable-persistence claims. Durable storage can be added as Book-owned coordination-state infrastructure with zero canonical manuscript effect and without requiring author/private/native/A-01/publication/production authority.

Concurrency rules explicitly prohibit execution/scheduler authority and classify work for later scheduling. This remains downstream/parallel open work but is not selected by this one-seam reconciliation.

selected_successor.scope: Implement a transport-neutral Book-owned durable store contract and reference adapter for workflow states, cancellation/resume checkpoints and evidence/provenance receipts using exact digest/version identity, append-only receipt semantics and stale-write/idempotency guards. The store may persist coordination metadata and immutable references only; it may not persist raw manuscript text through this seam or mutate Book canonical manuscript/Story Bible/canon/admission state.
